economy.summary: His campaign site says he will fight for jobs and economic development in the district and region so that everyone has an equal opportunity for a better life.
economy.short: Will fight for jobs and economic development in the district.

taxes.summary: His campaign biography says he authored legislation to prohibit a Pennsylvania tax on the federal stimulus checks of Pennsylvanians.
taxes.short: Authored legislation to prohibit state tax on federal stimulus checks.

abortion.summary: His campaign site says he will guarantee health care and reproductive rights; it does not detail specific abortion legislation.
abortion.short: Says he will guarantee health care and reproductive rights.

education.summary: His campaign site says he will fight for increased funding for public schools and work to find solutions to make college more affordable.
education.short: Will fight for increased public school funding, college affordability.

healthcare.summary: His campaign site says he will work to protect access to affordable health care, particularly for seniors. As the incumbent, he advanced legislation in July 2026 to increase access to occupational therapy.
healthcare.short: Will protect affordable health care access; advanced occupational therapy bill.

guns.summary: As the incumbent, he announced $242,000 in state grants for local firefighter and EMS services in February 2026 and describes himself as a strong supporter of first responders; he has not published a position on firearms policy.
guns.short: Supports first responders; announced fire and EMS grants; no firearms position.
